description: List the products/apps owned by the request scope's user. Returns a summary (count, brief one-liner, and a list of {id, name, description, url}) with no timestamps or internal flags. Use this for product inventory or explicit product-switch/disambiguation questions. A normal product-scoped request already carries an app_id in Scope; do not call this just to discover which product to use for product-aware actions.
name: list_apps
